definitions.definition: The act of checking in at a hotel, airport, etc.

quote.text: The hotel never charges for a late check-out or for an early check-in . . .

quote.citation: 1999, Pamela Brown, Tackling Racism: One Day Training Workshop:
quote.text: The implication was that Ms Purkiss had been stereotyped by the check-in staff as ‘foreign'.

definitions.definition: (computing) The submission of source code or other material to a source control repository.
The act of contacting another person in order to keep them informed of one's situation.
